seo.title: Series — Red Belly Black | Venom Guitars
seo.description: The Red Belly Black Series from Venom Guitars. Inspired by Australia's iconic venomous snake — available in 6-string, 7/8-string electric and 4/5-string bass configurations.

s4.k3: One of Australia's most iconic venomous snakes becomes one of Australia's most iconic guitar series. Deeply black body, striking red belly, and a bite that cuts through any mix. Available in 6-string electric, 7/8-string extended, and 4/5-string bass configurations.

s5.k4: The Australian Red-Bellied Black Snake is one of Australia's most iconic venomous snakes — known for its striking glossy black upper body contrasted by a vibrant crimson to pinkish underside. Commonly found along the east coast in wetlands, forests, and grasslands, this species is generally shy and prefers to avoid confrontation, though it will defend itself if threatened.
s5.k5: Despite its potent venom, bites are rarely fatal thanks to modern medical treatment. The red-bellied black snake plays an important ecological role, feeding on frogs, fish, small mammals, and other reptiles, helping maintain balance within its habitat. Its distinctive appearance and calm nature have made it a well-recognised and respected symbol of Australia's diverse wildlife.
s5.k8: One of Australia's most iconic venomous snakes — the "Red Bellied Black" — is the concept behind this design series. It brings the aesthetics of a deeply black body and neck/headstock with the striking red front, replicating nature's own breathtaking design language.
s5.k9: The guitar is available in your choice of configurations. Standard being 6 String Electric and 4 String Bass. 7, 8 String electric and 5 String Bass available on request.
s5.k12: Deep gloss black — as dark as the snake's dorsal scales
s5.k14: Striking resin red on the front face — nature's own warning colour
s5.k16: Queensland Maple, finished dark to match the black aesthetic

s6.k3: The Red Belly Black Series is available across multiple configurations to suit players of every style — from 6-string players to extended range shredders and bass players.
s6.k7: The flagship of the series. A full 25.5" scale 6-string electric built for players who want classic range with the unmistakable Venom aesthetic. Versatile enough for blues, rock, metal, and everything in between.
s6.k23: Drop the low B and open up a world of extended range tone. The RBBS-7SE keeps the same iconic aesthetics of the series but adds a 7th string for players who need more headroom in the low end — metal, prog, djent, or just curious.
s6.k39: For the players who want to go further. The RBBS-8SE pushes into baritone territory with a low F# string that opens up sonic landscapes impossible on a standard instrument. For the technically adventurous and the detuned masses.
s6.k55: The bass player doesn't get left out. The RBBS-4SB brings the Red Belly Black aesthetic to the low end — same striking black and red finish, same build quality, tuned for the fundamental groove. Standard E-A-D-G configuration.
s6.k71: Add a low B string and unlock the full extended range of modern bass playing. The RBBS-5SB is for the bassist who needs to go low and stay tight — studio, live, or anywhere a 4-string just doesn't reach far enough.
s6.k87: Want the Red Belly Black aesthetic in a configuration not listed above? Left-handed? Different scale length? Baritone tuning? Fanned frets? We can do it. The RBBS design language applied to your exact specification.
s6.k103: The Red Belly Black isn't just a colour scheme slapped on a generic body. Every design decision reflects the source material — the snake, the Australian landscape, the tension between beauty and danger. The body contours, the pickup placement, the hardware finish — all chosen for the complete aesthetic.
s6.k104: Style and materials specs are being finalised. We're in the process of completing the production documentation for each model variant. Want to be involved in shaping the final spec? Reach out now.
s6.k108: Precision bolt-on for easy future maintenance and neck replacements.
s6.k111: Hard-wearing gloss over resin art bodies. Unique every single time.
s6.k114: Every guitar leaves the workshop set up to play properly. No compromise.

s7.k4: All RBBS guitars are built to order. Reach out to discuss your configuration, timeline, and pricing. We'll put together a spec sheet and quote for your build.
